evidence_title: SECOND QUARTER PRODUCTION REPORT FOR THE THREE MONTHS ENDED 30 JUNE 2026
evidence_summary: Q2 2026 total copper and zinc production were broadly in line with the prior-year period; all five mines remained on track for full-year production guidance, while C1 cost guidance for Las Bambas, Khoemacau and Rosebery was revised downward after first-half performance. This current operating evidence supersedes the stale FY2025 non-cash-impairment profit warning for decision readiness, but it is not a direct profit or consensus revision.
next_required_evidence: Interim financial results and a reliable dated earnings/consensus revision series are still required before assigning a stronger earnings-direction conclusion.
monitor_trigger: Interim results, material production-guidance change, cost-guidance reversal or acquisition-funding impact.

evidence_title: INSIDE INFORMATION ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING THE ESTIMATE FOR INTERIM RESULTS OF 2026
evidence_summary: The issuer estimated H1 2026 revenue growth of 16%-19%, attributable net profit growth of 4%-10%, attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items growth of 6%-11%, and non-IFRS adjusted attributable net profit growth of 17%-22%. The economic content is positive despite the HKEX category label including Profit Warning.
next_required_evidence: Confirm the estimate in formal interim results and assess margin, order conversion and cash-flow quality.
monitor_trigger: Formal H1 results, material change in order growth, margin conversion or revised management estimate.

evidence_title: INSIDE INFORMATION ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING THE ESTIMATE FOR INTERIM RESULTS OF 2026
evidence_summary: The H1 estimate is a dated and falsifiable positive earnings catalyst: revenue is estimated up 16%-19% and non-IFRS adjusted attributable net profit up 17%-22%, with newly signed orders up more than 30% year on year. Formal interim results remain the next confirmation point.
next_required_evidence: Formal interim results should confirm the estimate and clarify margin, order conversion and operating cash flow.
monitor_trigger: Formal H1 results or any revision to the July 13 estimate.

evidence_summary: The issuer expects H1 2026 attributable profit to decrease approximately 38%-43% versus RMB3.177bn in H1 2025. It attributes the decline to RMB appreciation, rising labour/pension and raw-material costs, production ramp-up inefficiency, weak demand, tariff effects and foreign-exchange losses. This is a current, quantified direct negative earnings signal.
next_required_evidence: Require the August 25 interim results, margin bridge, order-demand evidence and proof that cost/FX/ramp-up pressures are stabilising before releasing the blocker.
monitor_trigger: H1 results on 25 Aug 2026, gross-margin recovery, order demand, FX movement or production-efficiency improvement.

evidence_summary: The August 7 profit warning is the same economic event as the earnings-revision blocker. It remains a high-materiality negative catalyst, but is not counted as a second blocker event across dimensions.
next_required_evidence: Use the August 25 interim results to test persistence, margin drivers and recovery conditions.
monitor_trigger: H1 results, order recovery, gross-margin improvement or reversal of FX/cost pressure.

evidence_summary: The issuer disclosed a material forward operating change: Nike online sales in mainland China will terminate from 1 January 2027 and the board expects a significant short-term negative impact. The affected channel represented approximately 22% of FY2025/26 revenue. This is current expectation-relevant negative evidence, but it is not a quantified profit forecast or analyst-consensus revision, so the earnings dimension is confidence-capped rather than counted as a second blocker.
next_required_evidence: Require quantified FY2026/27 revenue and profit impact, channel-migration evidence and updated management guidance before stronger earnings inference.
monitor_trigger: Updated earnings guidance, quantified Nike channel migration, interim trading update or formal profit warning.

evidence_summary: Nike formally notified the Group that existing online sales of Nike products in mainland China will terminate completely from 1 January 2027. The board expects the short-term negative impact to be significant; Nike online sales represented approximately 22% of FY2025/26 total revenue. Offline cooperation remains, but the channel loss is sufficiently material and directional to retain as a current investment blocker.
next_required_evidence: Require quantified migration to offline/other channels, replacement-brand contribution, gross-margin impact and revised earnings guidance before releasing the blocker.
monitor_trigger: Evidence of successful offline transfer, replacement revenue, updated guidance or quantified FY2026/27 earnings impact.
